name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.7 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 4 visits over 23 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 22 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 23 hours starting 2025-12-08, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 3.17 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
